title: A site build opens on the bashOS desktop: an icon for every repo, the site's own app first, and the profile and the console one click away

arg.name: identity_is_the_sites
an_icon_for_every_repo
off_site_requests
arg.script: (() => { const n = performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter((e) => !e.name.startsWith(location.origin)).length; if (n) throw new Error(n + ' off-site request(s) from the desktop'); return n; })()

arg.name: open_the_pinned_app
the_live_site_is_framed
back_to_the_icons
arg.script: (() => { const back = document.querySelector("button[aria-label='Home']"); if (back) back.click(); return Boolean(back); })()

arg.selector: text=has no interface of its own

arg.name: back_to_the_icons_again
arg.script: (() => { const back = document.querySelector("button[aria-label='Home']"); if (back) back.click(); return Boolean(back); })()

arg.name: open_the_profile
the_profile_is_at_home
classic_console_names_the_site

steps.arg: button[aria-label='Search every page, project and app']
